---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the layer or its documentation
---

<!-- markdownlint-disable-file MD041 -->

For vulnerabilities, use the private route in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/devdocsorg/meta-qcom-3rdparty/blob/docs/layer-documentation/SECURITY.md).
Search existing issues before submitting and remove confidential information.

## Problem

Describe the problem and identify the affected machine, branch, and commit.

## Reproduction

Give the smallest sequence of steps that shows the problem, including the exact
kas or BitBake command.

## Expected and actual result

Explain what should happen and what happens instead. Include error messages as
text.

## Context

Include related issues, the host distribution, and the kas-container version.
Omit fields that do not apply to the problem.
